Iran proposes new penalties for Strait of Hormuz rule violations

An Iranian parliamentary committee has approved new penalties for vessels violating rules in the Strait of Hormuz. The proposed measures include the seizure of 20% of a vessel's cargo and detention of the ship. These rules are intended to govern passage through the strategic waterway.
